The Chinese characters for Joel

As a transliteration, Joel is usually written 乔尔 (Qiáo ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

乔
Qiáo
tall, lofty
尔
ěr
you, thus

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Joel carries the meaning “Yahweh is God”.

About the name Joel

In the Bible, Joel was a minor prophet who foresaw the day of the Lord.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “Yahweh is God”, a Joel calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
